extracted.name: Greyhound cocktail
extracted.description: Mix a vibrant cocktail with pink grapefruit juice and gin or vodka. Much like a screwdriver, this is a simple classic with a fruity twist
ingredient_lines: wedge of grapefruit or slice of lime
instruction_lines: Fill a tall glass with ice, then add the gin or vodka.
Pour over the grapefruit juice, then stir using a long spoon. Garnish with a wedge of grapefruit or slice of lime.
